Now, I iterate through each object to see if any of its rows are present in the bottom half. Objects that intersect the bottom half of the grid are retained; otherwise, they are removed. I've been analyzing a filtering process. Specifically, I'm examining how components with a maximum row value less than a threshold are removed.
